name: @vulog/bo-widget-cli
description: Command line of Vulog back office widgets: validate and pack the zip to publish, run the fake back office against a real API.
author: Vulog

scripts.check:package: publint --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@vulog/bo-widget-cli'); if (typeof m.validateWidgetArchive !== 'function' || typeof m.packWidget !== 'function') throw new Error('@vulog/bo-widget-cli: exports not resolved from dist');" && node dist/bin.js --version
